The '''dishwasher''' was a type of job, usually with low [[Galactic Credit Standard|wages]].

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
In [[Roan Novachez]]'s second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] at the [[Jedi academy]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a training academy for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], he and several of his classmates were assigned to work together in a group to create a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. In the plans for the droid, designed for [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] training, which Roan dubbed the [[Multi-Armed Dueling Simulator Droid]] (M.A.D.S.), he suggested "cafeteria dishwasher" as a possible supplemental function.
{{Noncanonend}}

[[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] worked as a dishwasher in [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Given the job by [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]] of the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]], he toiled for little more than room and board, but gladly left his job when [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] informed him that he had been a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="tcwmissing" />

[[KT-18]], a housekeeping [[Droid/Legends|droid]] given by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as a gift, specialized in stain removal, dishwashing and window cleaning.
